description: This file defines the 'Group' data model and related functions for managing groups within the Mattermost platform, including validation, serialization, and associated types.

classes.name: Group
classes.description: Represents a user group with properties like ID, name, description, source, and member counts.

classes.name: GroupWithUserIds
classes.description: Extends Group to include a list of user IDs.

classes.name: GroupWithSchemeAdmin
classes.description: Extends Group with a scheme admin flag.

classes.name: GroupsAssociatedToChannelWithSchemeAdmin
classes.description: Associates groups to a channel with scheme admin info.

classes.name: GroupsAssociatedToChannel
classes.description: Associates multiple groups to a channel.

classes.name: GroupPatch
classes.description: Data structure for patching group properties.

classes.name: GroupStats
classes.description: Statistics related to a group, such as total member count.

classes.name: GroupModifyMembers
classes.description: Data structure for modifying group members.

classes.name: CreateDefaultMembershipParams
classes.description: Parameters for creating default group memberships.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of group properties for auditing.

methods.name: LogClone
methods.description: Returns a clone of the group data for logging.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of group with user IDs for auditing.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of group with scheme admin info for auditing.

methods.name: Auditable
methods.description: Returns a map of associated groups to a channel with scheme admin info for auditing.

methods.name: Patch
methods.description: Applies a patch to update group properties.

methods.name: IsValidForCreate
methods.description: Validates the group data for creation.

methods.name: requiresRemoteId
methods.description: Checks if the group requires a remote ID based on its source.

methods.name: IsSyncable
methods.description: Determines if the group source is syncable.

methods.name: IsValidForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the group data for update.

methods.name: IsValidName
methods.description: Validates the group's name for correctness.

methods.name: GetName
methods.description: Returns the group's name or empty string if nil.

methods.name: GetRemoteId
methods.description: Returns the group's remote ID or empty string if nil.

methods.name: GetMemberCount
methods.description: Returns the group's member count or zero if nil.
